It never materializes any child game state, performs a minimax/negamax oracle query, enumerates a game-continuation/response tree or compiles an alternate-future QBF/BDD; every qualified output is unrestricted exact P0 WDL plus complete labelled optimal move set.

sourceProofs.name: TWO_DISTINCT_OPPONENT_LIVE_SINGLETONS
sourceProofs.law: If opponent has >=2 distinct presently gravity-playable residual singleton threats, each non-immediately-winning mover action can occupy at most one threat cell; opponent's other first win remains available next turn. Thus each legal move's exact outcome is mover win iff its own source singleton completes immediately, otherwise opponent win. All action labels evaluated simultaneously from source; no game future.

sourceProofs.name: ONE_LEGAL_COLUMN_PARITY_DETERMINISTIC_FULL_FUTURE
sourceProofs.law: When exactly one nonfull column remains, all future owners are fixed by (occupiedRank+row-currentColumnHeight)%2. Earliest source residual whose every required cell has matching owner determines exact earliest winning terminal (or draw if none). This is direct parity arithmetic on source residuals, not traversal of the deterministic future moves.

sourceProofs.name: BOTH_PLAYERS_HAVE_NO_OPEN_WIN_REQUIREMENTS
sourceProofs.law: If R0 and R1 are both empty in a nonterminal source q, no subsequent cofactor can create a line; every legal move leads to draw.

sourceProofs.name: SAFE_GRAVITY_PAIRING_AND_NO_P1_WIN_PATH
sourceProofs.law: At P0-to-move source with no P1 unblocked winning requirements, select ONE deterministic matching of all remaining future cells in vertical consecutive same-column pairs and horizontal same-row equal-height column twins. Every playable P0 choice has a reply whose mate is immediately gravity-playable. If every P0 minimal residual requirement contains BOTH cells of some matched pair, P1 owns at least one cell in each target before P0 can complete it. P1 can never win because R1 empty; hence every P0 choice leads to exact draw. Static pair certificate selection scans source constraints but never evaluates game-continuation paths.
